findings.reason: §5's test 6 measures a guard behaviour that §6 does not implement and §6 is already landed and closed, so either §5 must drop the grandfathered-gap-reaches-done claim and test 6, or §6's guard must be widened to enumerate authored undeclared headings, which is a change to a landed section the plan's wave order (f-tick-005) does not name.
findings.text: §5 claims "at the transition into a terminal status, an authored heading with no declaration counts as an open section beside the declared ones, so its row must be declared and ticked before the plan closes", and its test 6 (line 145) asserts "the refusal naming that heading" while declaring its negative control to be that the test "fails when the terminal guard reads the declaration map alone"; but §6 (line 150-153) describes that guard as reading "§3's open-section predicate", and the landed guard `_require_every_section_ticked` (reckon/_store.py:3316) calls `_plan_html.open_sections(state)`, which returns only ids present in `section_declarations` (reckon/_plan_html.py:877-882) — an authored heading with no declaration is not in the map and is never counted, so under §6 as built a plan whose declared sections are all done can be set to done while still carrying an undeclared heading, the exact outcome §5 says cannot happen

rubric_items.anchors_resolve: pass — `_require_heading_for_section_records` (reckon/_store.py:1663), `_require_new_section_contracts` (reckon/_store.py:1697), `_write_state_locked` (reckon/_store.py:1244), `_replace_plan_text` (reckon/_store.py:1840), the server patch path (reckon/serve.py:3476) and `reckon audit-doc` all resolve; the extensionless hrefs name sections, not files.
rubric_items.done_when: pass — every §5 test names a declared negative control (a base revision or a stated mutation on which it fails), so no §5 measure is an assertion that holds however the code behaves.
rubric_items.evidence_paths: pass — §5's evidence is the recorded census and gate logs, which land under the repository's evidence record, not a session scratchpad or a node-local temporary path.
rubric_items.naming: pass — §5 carries no plan labels, stage names or ticket numbers into code; `section-without-todo`/`todo-without-section` are audit output vocabulary, not symbols.
rubric_items.reasoning: a finding — §5's grandfathered-gap invariant and its test 6 require a terminal guard that counts an undeclared authored heading as open, but §6 (landed) reads §3's declaration-only predicate, so an undeclared heading is invisible to it and §5's test 6 cannot pass without changing §6.
rubric_items.single_goal: pass — §5 carries one goal (the coverage control: audit reporting plus the write refusal) closed by one verdict.
rubric_items.wiring: pass — the plan declares no per-node depends-on/informs/gates relationships to be wrong; its only relationship tokens (`plan-depends-on: other`, `gates`) are quoted inside §9's prose about the roadmap, not plan-level wiring.
